import hashlib,json,pathlib,stat
root=pathlib.Path('/home/appontrack/public_html/saas/mobile/updates')
native=root/'native'
def sha(p):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with p.open('rb') as f:
  for chunk in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(chunk)
 return h.hexdigest()
nm=json.loads(json.loads((native/'latest.json').read_text())['payload'])
um=json.loads(json.loads((root/'latest.json').read_text())['payload'])
assert nm['version_code']==22, nm['version_code']
assert um['revision']==18 and um['min_native']<=20<=um['max_native'] and um['max_native']>=22, um
apk=(native/nm['file']).resolve();html=(root/um['file']).resolve()
assert apk.parent==native and html.parent==root
assert apk.stat().st_size==nm['size'] and sha(apk)==nm['sha256'],'APK integrity'
assert html.stat().st_size==um['size'] and sha(html)==um['sha256'],'HTML integrity'
assert bool(apk.stat().st_mode & stat.S_IROTH) and bool(html.stat().st_mode & stat.S_IROTH),'public read permission'
print(json.dumps({'status':'verified','native':22,'apk_size':apk.stat().st_size,'apk_sha256':nm['sha256'],'ota_revision':18,'html_sha256':um['sha256'],'no_key_reads':True}))
